driver: The decisive quantity is the standard error of a mean over entities that fail together through a shared parent node, so it has to be built over the nodes; an error that takes each entity as an independent unit understates it severalfold for a group concentrated behind few nodes, and the alert fires on what is node noise.
driver_concrete: The read-health standard fires on a firmware build whose mean installation read health sits three standard errors below 99.50; firmware waves go out collector by collector, so EM3.12.2's 153 assessed installations sit behind seven mesh collectors, and the one collector that missed Thursday night's collection took that day from 20 of its 23 EM3.12.2 installations at once: the standard error built over the collectors is 1.83 where the installation-level one is 0.40, and EM3.12.0's is 0.57 against 0.09, so both hold instead of stopping Wave 8 onto EM3.12.2.
stump: A competent solver executes MDS-STD-114 to the letter (installations that ran a build all week, reads held at the 06:00 AEST cut-off against every expected interval, the mean of installation read health) and takes the textbook standard error of that mean, the sample standard deviation over the square root of the installation count; that fires the alert on EM3.10.9, EM3.12.0, EM3.12.1, EM3.12.2 and PX5.2.7 and stops Wave 8's 1,274 moves onto EM3.12.2. The step that carries the stump is the unit of the error: installations behind one mesh collector lose the same nights together when it misses a collection, and a build pushed collector by collector sits behind few of them, so built over the collectors the standard error is 1.83 for EM3.12.2 and 0.57 for EM3.12.0, both hold, and the alert fires on EM3.12.1, EM3.10.9 and PX5.2.7 only.

differentiation.task98: task98 v3 formed units by chaining labelled members within a distance and applied a per-unit threshold to a filed count; here the units are stored and scored by a filed mean, and the move is the unit the mean's standard error is built over: the shared comms node rather than the installation, which no clause names and which the data's node-night failures force

Hardening loop 1 (2026-10-11): round 1 had both solvers execute the filed mean and the filed installation-level error (plain 91.3, skeptic 87.4, both landed); the standard now files the measure and three standard errors without naming the unit the error is built over, the head-end export carries each meter's comms parent, and the decisive rung is that unit (Layer 2 pattern moved from metric-definition/2 to complex-survey-estimation-variance/1); world, call shape and ask devices kept, the Wave 8 ask now applies the call. decisive_rule_filed true: MDS-STD-114 files the measure, the reference and the rule (fire below the reference less three standard errors of the build's read health) with sample-spread reporting; it does not name the unit the error is built over, which is a construction the data force (installations behind a node fail together; every dependence-respecting grouping gives the same call), and no sentence states or implies installation-level independence (official_decoy false). Hardening loop 2 (2026-10-11): round 2 had both solvers miss at the installation-level error; the ask layer was hardened (Wave 7 dropped, the distance from the limit and the 6.1 substitution load added) and the outage carve-out route closed (EM3.12.0's own gap and outage rates raised).
